learning_outcomes.text: Understand the fundamentals of joining processes and their classification.
Select and apply appropriate permanent joining techniques.
Select and apply appropriate detachable joining techniques.
Select and apply appropriate elastic joining techniques.
Able to work in a team, apply critical reasoning, make decisions, and communicate knowledge and conclusions in the field of industrial engineering.

syllabus_topics: Types of fusion welding: Arc welding
teaching_methods: Laboratory activities of increasing difficulty allowing students to acquire autonomy in problem-solving
Personal study, report writing, practical exercises as independent student or group work
assessment_rules: The final grade consists of 30% from two exams and 70% from practical reports. Each practical exercise contributes 7% to the final grade with no minimum mark required. Each of the two exams (Exam 1 covering Topics 1-3, Exam 2 covering Topics 4-7) contributes 15% to the final grade and requires a minimum score of 3. To pass the course, the overall average grade must be 5 or higher. For the ordinary resit, grades of 5 or higher for each part (exams or practicals) are retained, allowing the student to retake only the failed part. For the extraordinary resit, the student must retake the assessment for the entire course.
